{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: notifications/email/render.py (notifications side)

SHARED ACROSS ALL OCCASIONS:
- General problem: broken layout in the email renderer
- Signal: a table that overflows in the plain text part
- Repro: render the digest template with a long subject
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/notifications/test_render.py

EIGHT SEPARATE OCCASIONS WITH DISTINCT ROOT CAUSES AND FIXES:

[2026-01-06] OCCASION 1:
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #1360, branch fix/broken-layout-1)
Result: p99 latency fell from 1.8 s to 678 ms

[2026-02-03] OCCASION 2:
Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: an unbounded retry loop with no backoff
Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #1875, branch fix/broken-layout-2)
Result: flaky test went from 17 failures per hundred runs to zero

[2026-03-08] OCCASION 3:
Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #2176, branch fix/broken-layout-3)
Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 74 days running

[2026-03-15] OCCASION 4:
Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #2332, branch fix/broken-layout-4)
Result: throughput rose 18 percent, to 912 requests per second

[2026-03-19] OCCASION 5:
Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #2503, branch fix/broken-layout-5)
Result: cold start dropped 54 percent, to 177 ms

[2026-05-02] OCCASION 6:
Trigger: when the input list came in empty
Root cause: the config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #7268, branch fix/broken-layout-6)
Result: 5 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

[2026-05-07] OCCASION 7:
Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root cause: an off-by-one in the slice bound
Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #7564, branch fix/broken-layout-7)
Result: alert stayed quiet for 81 consecutive days

[2026-08-21] OCCASION 8:
Trigger: when two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: a naive datetime compared against an aware one
Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #9800, branch fix/broken-layout-8)
Result: error rate dropped from 1.3 percent to under 6 per ten thousand"}
